items.title: First Solar (FSLR) Backed New 15% US Polysilicon Tariffs
items.summary: First Solar (NasdaqGS:FSLR) has publicly backed a new U.S. policy that sets 15% tariffs and minimum import prices on polysilicon imports. The policy targets long running concerns about Chinese competition and supply chain risk for U.S. solar manufacturers. First Solar framed the move as a positive step for domestic manufacturing investments and future production plans.
